label: ASSUMPTION
note: Parameters of the F1 network built on the OpenStreetMap street graph. Every value is a synthetic placeholder, not ACUD data: terrain, pipe sizes, roughness, demand densities, the source and the tanks are chosen, not observed. Only the street geometry is public. Design (demo card D-02, the procedural rules of #59): a ground clearwell source 5 m above its site; the pumps sized for 1.2 x the average demand; three elevated tanks on the transmission main, all on one grade (bottom 30 m above the highest junction), switched by tank_0's level with one duty pump kept on; occupancy_fraction 0.12 of the planned rates (an early-phase city); 1.2 m transmission and 0.4 m submain pipes. Seven-day validation recorded in docs/progress/claude-code/D-02.md.
